rationale: C05 is a highly plausible drafting template: it is an immediately preceding disapproval memorandum concerning private immigration relief and follows the same concrete sequence—formulaic withholding of approval, identification of the alien and bill, explanation of the proposed immigration relief, chronological immigration and deportation history, evaluation of whether the individual facts justify special treatment, and a concluding refusal of approval. C10 and C06 share the general private-bill disapproval form and fact-specific evaluation, but their claims and legal machinery are materially less similar.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I AM WITHHOLDING my approval of S. 154, "For the relief of George Pantelas."
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I AM WITHHOLDING my approval of H.R. 692, "For the relief of Nina Makeef, also known as Nina Berberova."
shared_material.explanation: Nearly identical opening formula for disapproving a named alien's private relief bill.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The bill would authorize and direct the Attorney General to discontinue the pending deportation proceedings, cancel any outstanding order of deportation... and would exempt the alien from deportation in the future
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The bill would grant her the status of a lawful permanent resident... deportation proceedings were instituted. She was accorded a hearing and ordered deported.
shared_material.explanation: Both immediately describe the bill's exceptional immigration relief and then recount the alien's administrative deportation history.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The alien was born in Greece... He originally entered the United States in 1921... Thereafter, the alien re-entered the United States
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The alien is a native of Russia... She entered the United States in November 1950. Prior to that entry she had been a long time resident of France.
shared_material.explanation: Both use a compact biographical and chronological account of nationality, entry, residence, and immigration status as the factual core.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the record of bad conduct presented in this case convinces me that the granting of the relief proposed would not be in the best interests of the United States. Accordingly, I am withholding my approval from this bill.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There are no facts present in this case justifying the enactment of special legislation granting this alien preferential treatment... Accordingly, I am constrained to withhold my approval from the bill.
shared_material.explanation: Both close by applying an individualized justification standard to special immigration legislation and restating the withholding of approval.
